verdict.rationale: Capacities' built-in AI chat answers from your notes, plans multi-step work, and proposes creates and updates for approval. Chat Connectors also let ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or Le Chat act on a space, with version history to roll back unwanted edits. Together these are first-party natural-language operation of the product. Missing for 10: documentation of the full range of actions the AI can perform beyond proposing creates and updates, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The AI answers based on your notes, can plan multi-step work, and can propose creates and updates for you to approve.
Chat Connectors let you connect AI chat apps, like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or Le Chat, to your Capacities space.
If an external assistant changes a note in a way you do not want, use Version history on that object to preview and restore an earlier version.
After selecting blocks in your content, you can quickly launch the AI panel to perform tasks such as translation, rewriting, or summarization.
